input.quote: This Agreement will be governed by the substantive laws of the State of New York, without regard for its conflict of laws provisions.
input.rationale: § 14.3 selects New York substantive law, which matches our preferred governing law. However, the Agreement nowhere designates a dispute forum: searches for venue, jurisdiction, courts, dispute, and arbitration return only the severability and indemnity references to a "court of competent jurisdiction" (p0175, p0089, p0098), and §§ 14.4 (jury waiver) and 14.14 (two-year actions period) do not fix a forum. With no exclusive court venue, the clause fails both the preferred and the fallback forum element on a material term, leaving venue open to Vendor-favourable forum selection. We therefore add the shortest venue sentence at the preferred level (exclusive state and federal courts in New York County, with the customary temporary injunctive relief carve-out) and leave the New York law sentence verbatim. The jury waiver and limitation period are noted only, not redlined.

ops.text: The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York will have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or related to this Agreement, except that either party may seek temporary injunctive relief in any court of competent jurisdiction.
